items.title: Cosmetic Argan Oil
items.shortDesc: Morocco's liquid gold — rich in Vitamin E and fatty acids for skin and hair.
items.content: Cosmetic argan oil is rich in vitamin E, essential fatty acids, and nourishing compounds ideal for skincare and haircare. Lightweight and versatile, it suits facial oils, hair serums, massage oils, and luxury skincare formulas. Perfect for private label brands targeting natural beauty, clean skincare, and Moroccan-inspired cosmetics.

items.title: Food-Grade Argan Oil
items.shortDesc: Premium culinary argan oil with a rich nutty taste and natural fatty acids.
items.content: Food-grade argan oil uses roasted argan kernels, giving a rich nutty taste. Ideal for gourmet brands, wellness stores, and organic shops. It can be used in salads, dips, and traditional Moroccan recipes. Perfect for private label businesses entering the food and wellness market.

items.title: Prickly Pear Seed Oil
items.shortDesc: Ultra-luxurious rare oil loaded with antioxidants and Vitamin E.
items.content: Prickly pear seed oil is one of Morocco's most luxurious oils. Lightweight yet deeply nourishing, it's perfect for premium facial oils, anti-aging serums, eye care, and luxury skincare. Its high perceived value makes it excellent for private label brands seeking a premium positioning.

items.title: Nila Powder
items.shortDesc: Traditional Moroccan blue powder for face masks and brightening rituals.
items.content: Nila powder is a traditional Moroccan beauty ingredient with a striking blue color, used in hammam and skincare rituals. It refreshes the skin and supports a luminous complexion. Its unique color makes it viral-worthy for TikTok, Instagram, and e-commerce platforms.

items.title: Aker Fassi
items.shortDesc: Deep red Moroccan beauty powder — natural lip tint, cheek tint and mask.
items.content: Aker Fassi is made from poppy flower and pomegranate peel. Its natural deep red color connects beauty with Moroccan tradition. Perfect as a natural lip tint, cheek tint, or mask ingredient. Highly visual for social media marketing and Moroccan beauty ritual kits.

items.title: Moroccan Black Soap
items.shortDesc: The cornerstone of every hammam ritual — deep cleansing olive paste.
items.content: Moroccan black soap is essential for the traditional hammam ritual. Made from olive-based ingredients with a soft paste texture, it prepares the skin for exfoliation with a Kessa glove. Ideal for spas, body care brands, and hammam product collections. Sold in jars, tubes, or bulk.

items.title: Natural Soap
items.shortDesc: Customizable Moroccan soaps with argan oil, rose, ghassoul and more.
items.content: Natural Moroccan soaps are crafted with argan oil, olive oil, rose, lavender, ghassoul, honey, or essential oils. Easy to brand and package, they suit Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, spas, and gift shops. Ideal for eco-friendly brands with plastic-free packaging options.

items.title: Ghassoul Clay
items.shortDesc: Mineral-rich Moroccan clay for deep skin and hair cleansing.
items.content: Ghassoul (Rhassoul) clay is a natural Moroccan clay valued for its cleansing and absorbing properties. Used as a face mask, hair mask, or body mask. Available as powder, paste, or formula. Perfect for spa treatments, hammam products, and natural skincare brands.

items.title: Kessa Gloves
items.shortDesc: Traditional Moroccan exfoliating gloves — the ultimate hammam accessory.
items.content: Kessa gloves are traditional Moroccan exfoliating gloves used after black soap in hammam rituals. They remove dead skin cells leaving skin smoother and softer. Perfect accessories for hammam kits and upsells. Lightweight, easy to ship, and available in various colors and textures.

items.title: Rose Water
items.shortDesc: Pure Moroccan rose water — a gentle toner, mist and skincare essential.
items.content: Moroccan rose water is a refreshing beauty essential used as a facial mist, toner, or mask mixer. It pairs perfectly with ghassoul clay, Nila powder, and Aker Fassi. Simple yet premium, it suits natural skincare lines, spa products, and clean beauty brands worldwide.
